subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should one-way A2A handoff be added as a `sessions_send` mode, a separate one-way primitive, or deferred while only narrower A2A duplicate-delivery bugs are fixed?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes model-facing session semantics and could affect existing peer A2A coordination, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a typed dispatch mode that disables reply-back and announce for that call while preserving current conversation behavior by default.

options.title: Create separate delivery primitive
options.body: Add a new one-way tool such as `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue`, reducing ambiguity at the cost of another model-facing surface.

options.title: Defer one-way core API
options.body: Keep this open or close by product decision after landing narrower reverse-call and delivery fixes, leaving dispatch workflows to prompt/config workarounds for now.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Extend `sessions_send` with a typed dispatch mode that disables reply-back and announce for that call while preserving current conversation behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for session docs, helper semantics, and A2A lifecycle API decisions points to steipete.
